name: Angel Arms Foundation
tagline: Healing together — children and horses, side by side.

contact.address: Angel Arms Farm (update with your real address)

mission: To use the gentle power of horses to improve the lives of children with disabilities, while giving injured and retired horses the care, rehabilitation and lifelong home they deserve.
vision: A community where every child, whatever their ability, can grow in confidence and joy, and where every horse that has served us is treated with dignity for life.

values.title: Compassion
values.text: We meet every child, family and horse where they are.

values.title: Safety
values.text: Qualified instructors, trained volunteers and calm, well-cared-for horses.

values.title: Inclusion
values.text: Programs are open to children of all abilities and backgrounds.

values.title: Stewardship
values.text: Every donation is used carefully and reported openly.

programs.title: Equine-Assisted Therapy for Children
programs.text: Therapeutic riding and ground-based activities that help children with physical, sensory, developmental and emotional disabilities build strength, balance, communication and confidence.

programs.title: Horse Rescue, Rehabilitation & Retirement
programs.text: We take in injured and retired horses, give them veterinary care, hoof care, physiotherapy and good nutrition, and offer a peaceful home for life. Horses that are able may gently join our therapy program.

programs.title: Family & Community Days
programs.text: Open farm days, workshops for parents and carers, and school visits that bring people together around the horses.

funds.title: Children's Therapy Fund
funds.text: Pays for therapy sessions, adaptive riding equipment, qualified instructors and scholarships for families who cannot afford sessions.

examples.label: Helmet and safety gear for one child

funds.title: Horse Care & Therapy Fund
funds.text: Pays for veterinary treatment, farrier visits, feed, physiotherapy and a safe retirement for injured and retired horses.

examples.label: A week of feed for one horse
